source.candidate: uncommitted dev working tree; no push

configuration.production_benchmarks: Release -O3 -DNDEBUG; CPU-only; trace/perf output off; normal aura without AURA_FLOW_TESTING; B4 build also has separate aura_testing for diagnostic target
configuration.cpu: same unchanged flow_microbenchmark.cpp; 16 warmups, 101 timing samples, separate 25-call global C++ new window; five interleaved B3/B4 runs
configuration.graph: aura_testing diagnostic only; same clocks/counters and benchmark on B3/B4; budget 1; 256 unrelated active roots; group widths 32/128/512, nested depth 0/7; five warmups then 31 zero-timeout waits per scenario; five interleaved runs
configuration.wait_lock_ns: clock starts immediately after graph mutex acquired and ends immediately before guard releases it; includes all check/search/setup/destruction before release; excludes acquisition/unlock and timer counter update; diagnostic clocks/counters affect results
configuration.search_ns: search segment only, nested within wait region; excludes target mark/unmark in B4; do not substitute for whole wait critical-region time
configuration.idle: same unchanged production flow_idle_benchmark.cpp; model only; 200ms windows and 2300ms idle snapshot; five interleaved runs
configuration.counter_limits: context switches are not wakeups or power; new interception excludes malloc and driver memory; graph model is not business-frame or GPU-device latency

baseline_adapter.reproduction: prepare script into a new directory; configure Release BUILD_TESTING=ON AURA_BUILD_TESTS=ON ENABLE_TEST_XFLOW=ON ENABLE_OPENCL=OFF ENABLE_FLOW_BENCHMARKS=ON; build flow_graph_benchmark only
baseline_adapter.scope: test-only timing instrumentation, no B3 scheduler/graph algorithm changes; production B3 binaries stay frozen

style_phase.scope: first mechanical clang-format phase; final private timing seam added afterward and formatted again

format_only_patch.context: Zero-context mechanical style diff; use --unidiff-zero if reconstructing the intermediate phase. Final timing additions are separate.

validation.final_test_only_timing_seam: after full regressions, selected groups rechecked: CPU 6/6, ASan/OpenCL 4/4, TSan 3/3; production behavior unchanged
validation.baseline_preparation: fresh-directory adapter output matches instrumented baseline source; no current-repo mutation
